title: R24 TABLESTYLE border lineweight domain

source.specification: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.101.4; same project's CELLSTYLEMAP writer domain
source.finding: Border group 92 carries lineweight. The accepted numeric domain matches the adjacent CELLSTYLEMAP writer: -3, -2, -1, 0, 5, 9, 13, 15, 18, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 50, 53, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100, 106, 120, 140, 158, 200, 211.

implementation.behavior: The AC1024 TABLESTYLE writer admits the established lineweight set instead of only ByBlock (-2), while preserving the other border profile checks.

validation.result: Final build passed; focused CTest passed 1/1. Generated ASCII/Binary controls round-trip representative negative/default/positive lineweights across six borders, verify raw group-92 order and typed values, refuse value 1 with destination preservation, and retry on the same adapter.

qualificationLimits: The supported set matches the existing CELLSTYLEMAP writer domain; no physical producer witness is added.
Generated codec controls do not qualify native lineweight rendering.
No whole-file DWG/DXF support claim is promoted.
